phrases.speak: What if you could turn a location on Google Maps into a property you can explore?
phrases.show: What if you could turn a location on Google Maps into a property you can explore?

phrases.speak: Start with Google Maps. Find your land, switch to satellite view, and copy the location.
phrases.show: Start with Google Maps. Find your land, switch to satellite view, and copy the location.

phrases.speak: Maps shows the surroundings and the road. It does not give exact boundaries or measurements, so we treat everything as a concept.
phrases.show: Maps shows the surroundings and the road. It does not give exact boundaries or measurements, so we treat everything as a concept.

phrases.speak: Give Claude Code the location and describe your dream property. A modern house, a gate on the road, a pool, and a garden.
phrases.show: Give Claude Code the location and describe your dream property. A modern house, a gate on the road, a pool, and a garden.

phrases.speak: Claude Code coordinates Blender to turn the idea into an editable 3D concept. Walls rise, the roof drops, and the garden grows.
phrases.show: Claude Code coordinates Blender to turn the idea into an editable 3D concept. Walls rise, the roof drops, and the garden grows.

phrases.speak: Now watch it come alive. A car drives in from the road, the gate swings open, and the camera follows it inside. Every movement is real Blender keyframe animation.
phrases.show: Now watch it come alive. A car drives in from the road, the gate swings open, and the camera follows it inside. Every movement is real Blender keyframe animation.

phrases.speak: Walk through the garden. People stroll along the paths, the pool water ripples, and trees and plants add depth. Every detail stays editable.
phrases.show: Walk through the garden. People stroll along the paths, the pool water ripples, and trees and plants add depth. Every detail stays editable.

phrases.speak: Step up to the front door, open it, and explore the interior. A living room, a dining table, and warm light, all built in Blender.
phrases.show: Step up to the front door, open it, and explore the interior. A living room, a dining table, and warm light, all built in Blender.

phrases.speak: Then fly above the finished concept. Land photo, plan, and 3D design, side by side.
phrases.show: Then fly above the finished concept. Land photo, plan, and 3D design, side by side.

phrases.speak: Remember, this is a conceptual design. It is not construction drawings, and it needs real surveys and an architect.
phrases.show: Remember, this is a conceptual design. It is not construction drawings, and it needs real surveys and an architect.

phrases.speak: Follow Agentoon.ai for more real AI workflows!
phrases.show: Follow Agentoon.ai for more real AI workflows!
